rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase when reading or looking through something quickly without close attention.

example.english: When I do homework, I usually skim long articles.
example.traditional: 我做功課嗰陣通常飛住睇啲長文章。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zou6 gung1 fo3 go2 zan6 tung1 soeng4 fei1 zyu6 tai2 di1 coeng4 man4 zoeng1

rows.note: Use this all-purpose verb for something moving lightly over or brushing a surface, including the surface-gliding and surface-brushing senses.

example.english: I felt the leaves skim my hand as the wind blew.
example.traditional: 我感覺到啲樹葉畀風吹到掠過我隻手。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam2 gok3 dou3 di1 syu6 jip6 bei2 fung1 ceoi1 dou3 loek6 gwo3 ngo5 zek3 sau2

rows.note: Use this when removing scum, fat, or other floating material from the surface of a liquid, especially while cooking.

example.english: When making soup, use a spoon to skim the oil off the surface.
example.traditional: 煲湯嗰陣要用匙羹撇走面頭啲油。
example.jyutping: bou1 tong1 go2 zan6 jiu3 jung6 ci4 gang1 pit3 zau2 min2 tau4 di1 jau4
